criteria.text: Indication must be severe asthma (add-on maintenance) per Alaska Medicaid Tezspire PA Criteria.
Patient meets FDA-labeled age for Tezspire (severe asthma ≥12 years).
Prescribed by or in consultation with a pulmonologist, allergist, or immunologist.
Preceding year: ≥2 exacerbations requiring oral/injectable corticosteroid OR ≥1 exacerbation resulting in hospitalization.
Used as adjunct therapy with both medium-to-high dose inhaled steroid AND an additional controller medication (e.g. LTRA, LABA) for at least three months.
Will not be used for relief of acute asthma exacerbation or status asthmaticus.
Will not be used concomitantly with any other biologic product for asthma treatment.
Denial if patient is non-adherent to controller medication therapy.

max_units.notes: Tezspire: not to exceed 210 mg every 28 days. Initial approval up to 3 months; reauthorization up to 12 months. PDL non-preferred (IMMUNOMODULATORS, ASTHMA — OFF).

notes: Partial encoding from AK Tezspire™ (tezepelumab-ekko) Criteria Version 1 (Original 08/22/2023, Accepted 09/15/2023, Effective 11/1/2023).
Tezspire-encoded indication: severe asthma add-on maintenance only (age ≥12y). No phenotype/eos gate on this PDF (unlike IL-5 peers).

Encoded: closed indication list; FDA age ≥12y; specialty (pulmonologist/allergist/immunologist); prior-year exacerbation select (≥2 OCS/injectable or ≥1 hospitalization); adjunct medium–high ICS + additional controller ≥3 months; not-acute; no concomitant asthma biologic; controller adherence denial.

Not encoded as numeric predicates (attestation only): exact exacerbation counts, ICS dose mcg math, quantity 210 mg / 28-day math, live-vaccine / abrupt-steroid-taper cautions, reauth clinical-response detail (PDF gives duration only).

Alternatives: Dupixent/Xolair/Fasenra/Nucala/Cinqair evaluate()-linked for overlapping asthma. PDL preferred same-class peers (IMMUNOMODULATORS, ASTHMA) attach on fail via market basket. Tezspire itself is PDL non-preferred (OFF).
